def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])

    # Find full separator rows and columns.
    sep_rows = [r for r in range(h) if len(set(grid[r])) == 1]
    sep_cols = [c for c in range(w) if len({grid[r][c] for r in range(h)}) == 1]
    row_cuts = [-1] + sep_rows + [h]
    col_cuts = [-1] + sep_cols + [w]

    # The repeated separator color is not part of the panels.
    separator = grid[sep_rows[0]][0] if sep_rows else grid[0][sep_cols[0]]
    panel_cells = []
    for ri in range(len(row_cuts) - 1):
        r0, r1 = row_cuts[ri] + 1, row_cuts[ri + 1]
        for ci in range(len(col_cuts) - 1):
            c0, c1 = col_cuts[ci] + 1, col_cuts[ci + 1]
            panel_cells.append([
                grid[r][c] for r in range(r0, r1) for c in range(c0, c1)
            ])

    # Background is the most common non-separator color; the remaining
    # non-background color is the object counted in each panel.
    from collections import Counter
    counts = Counter(v for cells in panel_cells for v in cells if v != separator)
    background = counts.most_common(1)[0][0]
    objects = [v for v in counts if v != background]
    obj = objects[0]

    out = []
    k = 0
    for _ in range(len(row_cuts) - 1):
        row = []
        for _ in range(len(col_cuts) - 1):
            row.append(1 if panel_cells[k].count(obj) == 2 else background)
            k += 1
        out.append(row)
    return out
